notes: The possessive suffixes on both construct nominals are rendered, so each takes its own *their* under rule 18 and neither noun holds it.
The substantival Niphal participle `נִכְבְּדֵיהֶם` needs no supplied noun phrase here: the ASV writes a plain English noun for it beside the written possessive, so rule 46 has nothing to supply.
`כַבְלֵי בַרְזֶל` is rendered with *of*, so rule 19 puts the relational word on the rectum, headed on *iron*.
